wrap_env_with_episode_monitor: wrap a gym environment with EpisodeMonitor to track episode returns and lengths during training
monitor_episode_returns_and_lengths: use EpisodeMonitor to compute cumulative reward sums and episode lengths for each completed episode
track_total_timesteps: use EpisodeMonitor to track the total number of timesteps across all episodes in the info dict
reset_episode_stats: call reset on EpisodeMonitor to zero out reward sum, episode length, and restart the timer
normalize_episode_score: add a get_normalized_score method to EpisodeMonitor to normalize episode returns as a percentage
